earnings.title: INVESTOR CONTACT: MEDIA CONTACT:
highlights: Grew Net Sales 2.1% to $10.4 Billion, Net Income 42.5% to $218 Million and Diluted EPS 49.3% to $1.00
Grew Adjusted EBITDA 9.9% to $555 Million and Adjusted Diluted EPS 17.8% to $1.26
Net income margin increased 60 basis points to 2.1%

quotes.text: Our third quarter results reflect the strength of our strategy and disciplined execution, with continued market share gains and strong earnings growth.
quotes.by: Dave Flitman, Chair of the Board and CEO

quotes.text: Our third quarter performance reflects continued topline growth and EBITDA margin expansion, driven by ongoing operational excellence and disciplined cost management.

outlook: Net Sales growth of 4% to 5%, compared to previous guidance of 4% to 6%
Adjusted EBITDA growth of 9% to 11%, compared to previous guidance of 9% to 13%
Adjusted Diluted EPS growth of 18% to 20%, compared to previous guidance of 18% to 24%
The guidance provided above includes the impact of a 53rd week in fiscal year 2026, which is expected to add approximately 1% to total case growth and Adjusted EBITDA growth.
